ticket.title: Receipts carry the change they verified, not only a commit range
ticket.description:
Receipts record branch and commit window (SP-29), so the diff needs no new capture: git diff base..head. Two weaknesses. The window is the right unit for what a task changed but not for individual failed attempts. And a window of SHAs can be orphaned by rebase, squash or force-push, turning a record into a dangling pointer: the suite already has 44 edges whose target no longer resolves. So the receipt stores the diff content hash and the diff itself at verify time, and verification asserts that both ends of the window are still reachable, reporting orphaning honestly rather than silently. This is also what makes plan-to-implementation pairs usable without a checkout at an exact SHA.

DELIVERED AND VERIFIED 2026-11-10 (storypole 7a83e71 + 469e863, contract common 6e9f3a8). The receipt below is its own proof and it is checkable by hand: recorded diff_hash ad89910b21a6442cec2cc7094d1f53b6c81737e1 over window d49142b2..469e8636, and `git diff d49142b2 469e8636 | git hash-object --stdin` returns exactly that hash - so a reader with the repository can confirm the content independently, and a reader without it still has 19063 bytes of the diff in the receipt. window_intact is true at write time; the reader-side question is answered by revision::orphaned_window_warning, which storypole show now prints beside the unmerged-receipt warning and which re-checks the window against the repository the receipt names. The capture moved to ops/revision/change.rs when revision.rs reached 243 lines, tests followed into the sibling file. Known limit, stated: window_intact recorded at write time is nearly always true, because the commits existed a moment earlier - its value is as a promise, and the honest check is the reader-side one.
acceptance_criteria: a receipt survives a rebase of its branch with its diff hash intact; an orphaned window is reported, not passed over

verification_receipt.command: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo nextest run --workspace && miter audit --path . --threshold 250 --paths && chalkline docs check -d storypole
